method: BASELINE. Written straight from the deposited text from the seat of the individual to whom the law is applied, with the design defaults ruled on 2026-10-18; no REFUSE (conduct before 15 December 2001 for an offence outside the Code answers `not covered`, asserted); every matter of fact for the tribunal asked as an input; checked with the stable l4 of VS Code extension 1.6.98, JL4_LIBRARY_PATH unset. No pipeline, no coverage table, no independent test pass, no human gate.
